title: Ticked From Memory, Explained
subtitle: Runa Adegoke, Iben Chikere and Casimir Beng on which car-share checklist items renters check, and which they tick from memory
summary: A research explainer from the School of Emergent Priorities on Runa Adegoke, Iben Chikere and Casimir Beng's taxonomy of how closely car-share renters verify a return checklist. It follows the toll-transponder field from the checklist app's own log into the last five minutes before the late-return fee, where answers given from memory peak while the scheme's completion rate holds steady. Each of the three authors carries part of the account in their own voice.
topic: A research explainer of the paper cataloguing which items on a car-share return checklist renters check against the vehicle and which they tick from memory, as the late-return fee's deadline approaches and a compulsory photo step is added to the toll-transponder field
